verdict.rationale: Next.js documents a built-in MCP endpoint that lets coding agents programmatically access a running Next.js app, which is a first-party programmatic interface. A probe also found an OpenAPI spec at nextjs.org, but its scope and content are not described. API Routes are tools for building your own app's endpoints, not an API for driving Next.js, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: a documented reference for the API's operations and scope, evidence of what the OpenAPI spec actually exposes, auth/versioning details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving Next.js through it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Learn how to give coding agents access to your running Next.js app through the built-in MCP endpoint.
